plugin.name: Ultimate Spider-Man Widescreen Fix
MAIN_SkipIntro.description: Skip startup logos and the copyright screen. Restart after changing this value.
MAIN_HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Use Auto for full-screen HUD width, or 4:3, 16:9, 21:9 or a custom ratio up to 32:9. Changes apply at the next game frame.
MAIN_FPSLimit.description: Target frame rate. Zero retains the native frame lock. Restart after changing this value.
MAIN_FOVFactor.description: Gameplay field-of-view multiplier, from 0.5 to 2.0. 1.0 preserves the corrected original view. Comic panels, scripted cameras and native zoom views keep their own framing. Applies at the next game frame.
MAIN_DrawDistanceScale.description: Scale world draw and streaming distance. Values above 2 expand allocations experimentally and may cause crashes. Restart after changing this value.
GRAPHICS_SMAA.description: Apply SMAA before the UI. Incompatible with native MSAA. Changes apply while the game is running.
GRAPHICS_ConsoleGamma.description: Apply the console-style gamma curve for deeper contrast. Changes apply while the game is running.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game client area. Releases on focus loss, window dragging, system menus or when disabled. Independent of mouse input.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window at the selected resolution, or borderless at the monitor resolution. Changes apply at the next game frame. Alt+Enter returns to the last window mode.
